notes.title: Update log V1.1.4.0508.1 New blueprint sharing feature
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, long time no see (๑╹◡╹)ﾉ. In this update, I'll be sharing the blueprint of the upcoming content with you all. This time, our blueprints can be shared and imported individually, so you no longer need to worry about which blueprint to use.

[h3]Added Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added blueprint sharing feature
[*] Added new blueprint import feature
[/list]
Blueprint Sharing and Import Methods:
1. (*Recommended) Share a single blueprint: In the game, you can click the share button, copy the generated blueprint data code to a text editor like Notepad, and share the text file containing the blueprint data with others. To import a single blueprint, you need to copy all the content from the text file storing the blueprint data, paste it into the game after pressing the import button, and it will be successfully imported.
2. Share the entire blueprint: You can find the blueprint file at this path: Navigate to "River Town Factory" in the game library → Right-click → Manage → Browse Local Files → Save folder → blueprint file. Note that this sharing method can only replace blueprints and is not suitable for importing or merging blueprints individually.

[h3] Translation Corrections[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the error in English where the opening "Heirloom Bracelet" was described as "Heirloom Hracelet"
[*] Fixed the issue in English where there was no spacing between task completion prompts
[*] Fixed the grammar error in English in the birthday description on the calendar interface
[*] Fixed the English introduction of Xu Fuchun, where "Lin Shan Shi" was corrected to "Lin Shanshi"
[*] Fixed the English introduction of Cao Yunhui, where "Luwei" was corrected to "Lu Wei"
[*] Fixed the English introduction of Hong Xian, where "LiYan" was corrected to "Li Yan"
[*] Fixed grammar and syntax errors in the English storyline
[/list]

[h3]Multilingual issue resolution[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue in multiple languages where there was no spacing between the marriage status on the favorability interface
[*] Fixed the issue in multiple languages where there was no spacing between the favorability increase/decrease prompts

[/list]

notes.title: V1.0 is now available！Update log V1.0.1.0207.1
notes.notes:
✿✿ヽ(°▽°)ノ✿Hello there, dear Workshop Owners! I have some thrilling news to share with all of you. Guess what? Today, our game has officially transformed from EA to V1.0 full version! It's been an incredible journey, and after almost a year of hard work, we've reached this milestone. I want to take a moment to express my heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you for being there with us every step of the way. Your trust and support mean the world to us! But hold on, the adventure doesn't end here. We're still dedicated to bringing you more updates and exciting features. In fact, our next major update will introduce the Creative Workshop! So get ready for even more fun and surprises coming your way!

[h2]V1.0 Arcane Skyrush overview：[/h2]

[h3]Additions:[/h3]
[list]
[*] T8 repair nodes opened
[*] New building [Ultrafast Transport Belt]
[*] New building [Ultrafast Underground Belt]
[*] New building [Assembly Platform]
[*] New building [Command Center]
[*] Opened technologies related to DI-Crystal
[*] Opened recruitable character [Han Shan]
[*] Opened recruitable character [Liu Sanniang]
[*] Opened Qingming Festival [Banish Monster Gathering] event (Festival time: 24th of Spring)
[*] Opened External Martial Arts [Secular Palms], available for exchange at Qingming Festival Shop
[*] Opened game ending
[*] Added 3 achievements
[*] Added plot acceleration feature, press Ctrl to speed up during plot progression
[*] Added super large oil fields located within the floating island map
[*] Added the ability to discard items in backpacks and various types of chests
[/list]
[h3]Modifications:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added directional prompts when constructing conveyor belts
[*] Rocket Silo can now be equipped with satellite modules
[*] Reduced collection time for Auto Gatherer from 80s to 40s
[*] Display manufacturing time for Auto Gatherer

[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

[*] Fixed issue where River Town Gate could be selected in blueprints

notes.title: [Floatland Secret] Update log V0.9.0.1220.1

[*] Add English support.

[*] Add 8 factory products: Energy Module A, Mechanical Core, Superalloy, Radiator, Organic Energy Block, Space Structure, Space Fuel, and Space Engine.
[*] Add Technology Tree: T7-related technologies and unlimited improvement of martial arts technology.
